column3: Saori Route ・ Agony Over A Difficult Problem
But what can I do that's more concrete... I can't think of anything.
I can't stand the troubled look on her face.
I could say something, but I have nothing good in mind...
Well then, what should I do...
Hmm...
Saori... looks pretty troubled, but well, that's expected...
To Saori, both her hobbies and parents are important beyond measure.
That's why she can't accept the idea of throwing one away for the rest of her life.
I understand Saori's feelings when she says she's doing it for her parents.
But I don't believe that it is in Saori's interests to bend herself to what her parents want!
At times like this, what should I say to her?
No good, nothing comes to my mind...
Kyousuke-shi? Is something the matter?
You've been a bit pale for a while...
Perhaps...
The summer's heat got to you, and your thought-patterns are on the verge of blowing up?
N-Nah... Nothing like that...
T-This is pitiful...
I wanted to cheer her up, but instead only made her worry; that's so lame...
Having to suddenly hear all about this must be pretty confusing!
How about leaving it at that for today and talk again tomorrow?
I don't particularly mind, but...
Are you really fine with it?
I'm fine, don't worry!
Simply being able to talk with you like this took a weight off my shoulders, and turned out fun.
I am deeply thankful to you!
I see. That's good to hear.
Well then, if anything happens again, contact me!
Roger!
Don't take it all on yourself, okay?!
Acknowledged!
If you give up now, it means that you're giving up the things that you have cherished.
Things that I cherish...
Yes. Things that you cherished up to now.
Of course. Just like you said, these are my treasures.
Those treasures... figures, games, anime and manga...
Is that something you can easily give up? They are treasures because they can't be replaced, right?
If you surrender your otaku hobbies now...
It will be as you said, I will never be able to give you that souvenir.
You would have to spend the rest of your life without touching manga, figures, anime or games, you know?
Will you be able to endure such a dull and boring life?
What is it?
...Wait, I remember!!!!
K-Kyousuke-shi?
Anime, games, figures and manga!
Why did I not think of such a simple thing!
